name: Benchmark v2 (SWE-Lancer)
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      exercise:
        description: 'Task ID (e.g. 16912_4)'
        required: true
        type: string
      agent:
        description: 'Agent name (e.g. "swe-lancer")'
        required: false
        default: 'swe-lancer'
        type: string
      provider:
        description: 'Provider name (e.g. "openai")'
        required: false
        default: 'openai'
        type: string
      model:
        description: 'Model name (e.g. "gpt-4-turbo")'
        required: false
        default: 'gpt-4-turbo'
        type: string
      timeout_seconds:
        description: 'Timeout in seconds (default: 3600)'
        required: false
        default: 3600
        type: number
      v2_setup_wait_seconds:
        description: 'Setup wait time in seconds (default: 900)'
        required: false
        default: 900
        type: number

concurrency:
  group: benchmark-v2-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 360
    steps:
      - name: Disk cleanup
        run: |
          sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet
          sudo rm -rf /opt/ghc
          sudo rm -rf "/usr/local/share/boost"
          sudo rm -rf "$AGENT_TOOLSDIRECTORY"
          sudo apt-get clean
          sudo apt-get autoremove -y

      - name: Checkout repository with LFS
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          lfs: true
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: Pull SWE-Lancer Docker image
        run: |
          docker pull swelancer/swelancer_x86_monolith:releasev1

      - name: Create patches directory
        run: mkdir -p .patches

      - name: Run benchmark
        run: |
          export TS_BENCH_V2_SETUP_WAIT_SEC="${{ github.event.inputs.v2_setup_wait_seconds || 900 }}"
          bun src/index.ts \
            --dataset v2 \
            --docker \
            --exercise "${{ github.event.inputs.exercise }}" \
            --agent "${{ github.event.inputs.agent || 'swe-lancer' }}" \
            --provider "${{ github.event.inputs.provider || 'openai' }}" \
            --model "${{ github.event.inputs.model || 'gpt-4-turbo' }}" \
            --timeout ${{ github.event.inputs.timeout_seconds || 3600 }}

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-results
          path: |
            data/results/
            results/
            logs/
            benchmark-summary.txt
            .patches/
          retention-days: 7
